subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward successfully loaded images when some same-turn Telegram/channel image attachments fail, or should the existing all-or-nothing prompt-ref fallback remain the product contract?
rationale: Current main already hydrates the ordinary single-image path, but the linked closing PR intentionally changes partial-media delivery semantics in a shared channel path and previous review found that the implementation needs source-alignment repair before it can be accepted.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the prompt-image boundary, adding missing-first and missing-middle coverage, and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback and close or narrow the linked PR if partial native delivery is not the desired contract.

options.title: Close as already handled
options.body: If maintainers decide the shipped single-image hydration is enough for this report, close the linked PR first and then close this issue with the shipped fix evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the prompt-image boundary, adding missing-first and missing-middle coverage, and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc most recently merged the same resolver's mixed image-order contract, which is the central contract choice for the remaining PR.
